description: One company in one call: by default its overview (its latest figures and measures, its key findings with their documents, its peers and a summary of its lenders, customers, suppliers and owners). include adds any of findings (the key findings of the latest snapshot), history (every record of the findings ledger), events (corporate events), quality (withheld and restated values), snapshots (every published version with its time), info (units, sign conventions, fiscal calendar), documents (the source documents) and relationships; at gives the snapshot that was the latest on a date. The answer names whether the company reports quarters or fiscal years only and its latest period, available lists the parts not in the answer, and not_included states what the answer leaves out and the call that gives it.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

company.description: the company of a search result (apple), its id from fetch (company:apple), or a ticker or CIK

include.description: the parts of the answer (default overview, or info with at)

limit.description: entries of a part that lists values, such as quality (default 50)

name: get_company
title: Get a company
